# Awesome 4D Gaussian Splatting

A curated list of papers, project pages, code, and datasets for dynamic Gaussian splatting.

[![Awesome](https://awesome.re/badge.svg)](https://awesome.re)
[![License: CC0](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-CC0--1.0-lightgrey.svg)](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/)

</div>

> Last curated: **2026-07-23**

This list uses **4DGS** broadly: native 4D Gaussian primitives, deformable or time-conditioned 3D
Gaussians, and closely related dynamic Gaussian representations. Focused sections intentionally
repeat relevant papers so they remain useful on their own.

Every paper title links to arXiv. A blank **Code** cell means that no public implementation was
verified at the time of the last update; placeholder repositories and "coming soon" announcements
are not listed as code.

learned forward pass, rather than optimizing a new representation from scratch for every sequence.

## Datasets

Frequently used dynamic-scene and dynamic-human datasets. The **Data / Project** column points to
the official download or access page when one exists; the final column contains public tooling or
reference implementations.

| Dataset                  | Scope                                     | Paper (arXiv)                                                                         | Data / Project                                                                | Code / Tools                                                  |
| ------------------------ | ----------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------- |
| PackUV-2B                | Long-duration multi-view volumetric video | [PackUV](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.23040)                                            | [Project](https://ivl.cs.brown.edu/packuv/)                                   |                                                               |
| PhysGaia                 | Physics-aware multi-body dynamics         | [PhysGaia](https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.02794)                                          | [Hugging Face](https://huggingface.co/datasets/mijeongkim/PhysGaia/tree/main) | [GitHub](https://github.com/mjmjeong/PhysGaia)                |
| 4DNeX-10M                | Large-scale animated-asset corpus         | [4DNeX](https://arxiv.org/abs/2508.13154)                                             | [Hugging Face](https://huggingface.co/datasets/3DTopia/4DNeX-10M)             | [GitHub](https://github.com/3DTopia/4DNeX)                    |
| DNA-Rendering            | Multi-view human performances             | [DNA-Rendering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2307.10173)                                     | [Project / access](https://dna-rendering.github.io/)                          |                                                               |
| ActorsHQ                 | High-resolution multi-view humans         | [HumanRF](https://arxiv.org/abs/2305.06356)                                           | [Project / access](https://actors-hq.com/)                                    |                                                               |
| DyCheck iPhone           | Casual monocular dynamic scenes           | [Monocular Dynamic View Synthesis: A Reality Check](https://arxiv.org/abs/2210.13445) | [Project](https://kair-bair.github.io/dycheck/)                               | [GitHub](https://github.com/KAIR-BAIR/dycheck)                |
| ENeRF-Outdoor            | Outdoor multi-view human performances     | [ENeRF](https://arxiv.org/abs/2112.01517)                                             | [Project](https://zju3dv.github.io/enerf/)                                    | [EasyVolcap](https://github.com/zju3dv/EasyVolcap)            |
| HyperNeRF                | Monocular topologically varying scenes    | [HyperNeRF](https://arxiv.org/abs/2106.13228)                                         | [Project](https://hypernerf.github.io/)                                       | [GitHub](https://github.com/google/hypernerf)                 |
| Plenoptic Video / DyNeRF | Synchronized multi-view dynamic scenes    | [Neural 3D Video Synthesis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2103.02597)                         | [Project / data](https://neural-3d-video.github.io/)                          | [GitHub](https://github.com/facebookresearch/Neural_3D_Video) |
| ZJU-MoCap                | Multi-view articulated humans             | [Neural Body](https://arxiv.org/abs/2012.15838)                                       | [Project / access](https://zju3dv.github.io/neuralbody/)                      | [GitHub](https://github.com/zju3dv/neuralbody)                |
| D-NeRF                   | Synthetic monocular dynamic scenes        | [D-NeRF](https://arxiv.org/abs/2011.13961)                                            | [Project](https://www.albertpumarola.com/research/D-NeRF/index.html)          | [GitHub](https://github.com/albertpumarola/D-NeRF)            |
